about_the_game:
OptimizeMan: Gymcel is an experimental, grotesque, satirical, gym simulation.

Play as OptimizeMan, a regular guy grinding at the Hypermaxx Facility, where the pressure to level up physically and mentally slowly distorts reality.

Key Features:

  • Daily Todo List: Each morning you must pick 3 tasks for your daily todo-list, failing them is at expense to your sanity.

  • Workout Minigames: Try to lift as heavy as you can without rupturing your bicep, or play it cool and go for reps.

  • Social Simulator: Pursue friendships with gibberish speaking NPC's who are constantly judging you, or ignore them all and go goblin mode.

  • Weird Muscle Deformations:  Gain strength and watch your muscles bulge.  Does the receptionist mog you with her pristine chiseled jawline?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 @ 2,80 GHz, AMD FX 8120 @ 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 630 / 650m, AMD Radeon HD6570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card

short_description: Welcome to the Hypermaxx Facility. You are OptimizeMan, society’s default build. An average man dropped into a world that worships the extraordinary. Failure is not an option.
supported_languages: English, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Thai
